subject: [PATCH v3 18/18] selftests/mm: zap whole PTE tables in the khugepaged race harness

2026-08-12.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged race harness to occasionally zap a whole PMD-aligned area of page tables, rather than just individual pages or sub-tables. This is done by adding a new condition that causes the thread to zap a full table once every 64 iterations. The goal is to trigger the empty-table reclaim mechanism (CONFIG_PT_RECLAIM) in scenarios where it was previously not reachable. The patch aims to improve the test's ability to catch potential issues related to page table handling.
